     Every normative change requires a citation. Proposals without one will be returned.

## Type of Change

- [ ] Typo / formatting fix _(no review required beyond CI)_
- [ ] Factual correction _(requires 1 maintainer approval)_
- [ ] New field or data element _(requires Discussion + 2 maintainer approvals)_
- [ ] Change to existing normative requirement _(requires Discussion + 2 maintainer approvals)_
- [ ] New section _(requires Discussion + 2 maintainer approvals)_
- [ ] Documentation / informative content only

## Checklist

- [ ] I have updated `CHANGELOG.md` under `[Unreleased]`
- [ ] My change is scoped to one concern (not mixing multiple unrelated edits)
- [ ] I have cited a supporting standard, law, or documented practice (for normative changes)
- [ ] I have considered privacy implications if this change involves personal data fields
- [ ] I have checked that my change does not conflict with existing sections
